outcome: Subclinical myocardial dysfunction (impaired left ventricular global longitudinal strain < 20%)
Early carotid atherosclerosis (common carotid artery intima-media thickness >= 0.7 mm)
cohort: The study included 31 women with previous hypertensive disorders of pregnancy and 30 age- and BMI-matched normotensive healthy women as controls.
finding: A history of pre-eclampsia is independently associated with a higher risk of subclinical myocardial dysfunction and early carotid atherosclerosis at six years postpartum.
